basic_details.job_title: IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation Multi-Tasking Staff Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation, a Section 8 Company under the Companies Act 2013 promoted by Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW), Delhi, is filling one Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) post purely on contract, initially for one year, with salary as per the Labour Department, GNCTD order. Applicants need a 10th pass with minimum 50% aggregate, three years' experience and age below 50 years. The application, with the Annexure A CV and a photograph, should reach the office by 8 December 2026, 5.00 PM, and also be emailed to [email protected].

how_to_apply: Prepare the CV in the prescribed format given as Annexure A, filled in block letters; an extra sheet may be attached if a column has too little space.
Attach one photograph and self-attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates.
Address the application to: The Managing Director, IGDTUW Anveshan Foundation, Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW), Kashmere Gate, DELHI – 110006.
Make sure the application reaches the office by 8 December 2026, 5.00 PM.
Also email the same to [email protected] by 8 December 2026 (Tuesday).

Annexure A asks for name, date of birth, age on 08/12/2026, father's or husband's name, permanent and correspondence addresses, telephone, mobile and email, marital status, gender, nationality and category, together with education details (Matric/SSC/10th Class, 10+2 or equivalent, any other) and experience details starting with the latest. It ends with a signed declaration by the candidate.
CV in the prescribed format (Annexure A)
Self-attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates
important_instructions: IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation reserves the right to fill or not to fill any or all of the posts advertised. Applicants already in employment in a Government Department, Autonomous Body or University under Central or State Government should apply through proper channel. Incomplete or unsigned applications, and applications without a photograph, will be rejected. No TA/DA will be paid for submitting the application form or for appearing in the interview. Selected candidates will be required to join on very short notice. If any information in the application is found to be false, the candidate's services are liable to be terminated without notice, as the Annexure A declaration states.

content_sections.heading: About IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation
content_sections.text: IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation is a Section 8 Company under the Companies Act 2013, promoted by Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women, Delhi (established by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi vide Act 9 of 2012). The notice says it was incorporated on 13th October 2016, is recognised by the Department of Science & Technology (DST) as a TBI, and describes itself as a leading Incubation Center of NCT Delhi. This is a contract post with the Foundation, not a regular government post.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: The notice states that the prescribed educational qualifications are minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to a call for interview or selection. It prints no age relaxation and no desirable qualification.

rows.details: Minimum High School (10th Standard) pass with minimum 50% aggregate
Minimum three years of work experience in an established and registered organisation
Below 50 years of age as on the closing date of application

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: Salary is as per the order of the Labour Department, GNCTD, vide F. No. (142)/02/MW/VII/Part File/211–241 dated 15th April 2025. The notice prints no rupee amount. Nature of engagement: contractual, initially for a period of one year, with a notice period of one month applicable to either party. Extension: the contractual engagement may be extended, based on the candidate's performance, up to a maximum total tenure of three years. Leave entitlement: 08 Casual Leaves, 02 Restricted Holidays and 10 Medical Leaves per year.

Address the application to: The Managing Director, IGDTUW Anveshan Foundation, Indira Gandhi Delhi Technical University for Women (IGDTUW), Kashmere Gate, DELHI – 110006. Make sure the application reaches the office by 8 December 2026, 5.00 PM. Also email the same to [email protected] by 8 December 2026 (Tuesday). Annexure A asks for name, date of birth, age on 08/12/2026, father's or husband's name, permanent and correspondence addresses, telephone, mobile and email, marital status, gender, nationality and category, together with education details (Matric/SSC/10th Class, 10+2 or equivalent, any other) and experience details starting with the latest. It ends with a signed declaration by the candidate. Documents named in the notice: CV in the prescribed format (Annexure A) One photograph Self-attested copies of all qualification and experience certificates

content_sections.text: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. The notice does not give the interview date, venue or the basis of shortlisting.

faq.question: Q1. How many Multi-Tasking Staff posts has IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation announced?
faq.answer: The notice announces 1 (One) Multi-Tasking Staff (MTS) post, purely on contract.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation MTS post?
faq.answer: The application should reach the Foundation's office by 8 December 2026 (Tuesday), 5.00 PM, and should also be emailed by 8 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the MTS post?
faq.answer: Minimum High School (10th Standard) pass with minimum 50% aggregate, plus minimum three years of work experience in an established and registered organisation.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the MTS post?
faq.answer: The applicant should be below 50 years of age as on the closing date of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the MTS post?
faq.answer: Salary is as per the order of the Labour Department, GNCTD, vide F. No. (142)/02/MW/VII/Part File/211–241 dated 15th April 2025. No amount is printed in the notice.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for the IGDTUW-Anveshan Foundation MTS post?
faq.answer: Send your CV in the Annexure A format with one photograph to The Managing Director, IGDTUW Anveshan Foundation, Kashmere Gate, Delhi – 110006, and email the same to [email protected].

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Only shortlisted candidates will be called for interview. Meeting the minimum qualification does not by itself entitle a candidate to an interview call or selection.

faq.question: Q8. Is the MTS job permanent?

faq.question: Q9. What leave does the MTS post carry?

faq.question: Q10. Will TA/DA be paid for the interview?
